{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
patient_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]

# Print number of patients with multiple rows and the count of such patients
print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicates)}")
print(f"Total number of duplicate rows: {duplicates.sum() - len(duplicates)}")

# Show the first few duplicate patient IDs
print(f"First few duplicate patient IDs: {duplicates.index[:5].tolist()}")"}
